en: Black‑and‑white waterfront view showing a harbor with a ferry or small passenger ship in the foreground and a quay lined with multi‑story historic buildings behind it. A tall column with a statue stands near the center of the quay, and a clock‑towered brick building rises in the background. The scene is taken from across the water, with the choppy surface of the inner harbor in the foreground. In the lower right corner, caption text is printed on the image.
